value.rationale: The first defect below square-block saturation is a canonical and complete boundary family, not a hand-picked matrix slice. It forces three top/socle profiles, gives exact finite-field module isomorphism class counts retaining the algebra action, and detects a precise one-dimensional change between self-centralizing and non-self-centralizing modules. The classification and commutant information are distinct from the classical degree inequality and are of natural use in modular representation and centralizer studies.
